newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel slumps to new year low.
newsitem.headline: SingTel slumps to new year low.

text.p: The slide in the value of Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) stock continued on Thursday with shares striking a new low for the year of Singapore $2.50, seen as a key support level by analysts.
SingTel shares slumped to S$2.50 in afternoon trade, falling from a previous 20-month low of S$2.65 which was hit on Tuesday.
Analysts said S$2.50 was a key support as it was the price of the second public offer of SingTel shares being made by the government.

SingTel shares were the most actively traded on the Stock Exchange of Singapore at 0800 GMT with 6.5 million shares changing hands helping the price recover to S$2.53, down S$0.09 from its Thursday opening.

Earlier on Thursday MobileOne, SingTel's three week-old mobile phone rival, said it had grabbed almost 10 percent of cellular phone business in Singapore, previously dominated by SingTel's monopoly status before April 1's liberalisation.
